data.description: Exploring Dubai Academic City: A Hub of Residential and Lifestyle Excellence

data.answer:
Paradise Hills community is envisioned as a lifestyle destination, integrating city convenience with serene, nature-inspired surroundings. Residents will enjoy lush greenery, themed walking trails, and landscaped water features. Designed to prioritize wellness, the community includes dedicated jogging and cycling tracks, a pet-friendly dog park, and round-the-clock security.

Families can make the most of social and recreational spaces, including a multi-purpose activity hall and themed entrances, enhancing the residential experience. The gated community's emphasis on safety and serenity makes it a strong option for both end-users and investors.

Paradise Hills, Golf City Dubai, presents five distinct property types across 170 exclusive residences, ranging from 3 to 6-bedroom configurations. The 3 and 4-bedroom Calm townhouses span 3,000 to 3,500 sq. ft., featuring double-height ceilings, private pools, and large backyards.

The 4-bedroom Harmony Townhouses offer even more space, with 4,000 sq. ft. across G+2 floors and include an internal elevator, two living halls, and a bedroom on the ground floor. For larger families, the 5-bedroom Heaven and 6-bedroom Eternity pent suite villas offer 5,300 and 6,850 sq. ft. respectively, complete with rooftop terraces and private swimming pools.

Buying a Property in Paradise Hills Dubai

The development offers luxury at a competitive edge. Average sales prices for villas stand at AED 4.2M for a 4-bedroom and AED 9.95M for a 6-bedroom villa. With high-end specifications and a master-planned layout, Paradise Hills villas for sale cater to buyers looking for both lifestyle and long-term value.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Paradise Hills?

data.answer:
Life in Paradise Hills is designed for comfort and convenience. From landscaped gardens to themed parks and wellness amenities, every aspect of the Paradise Hills community fosters a peaceful and active lifestyle.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in Paradise Hills

Each villa includes a private two-car garage with an automatic door, and ample on-street parking is available for visitors. Residents benefit from easy access to Sheikh Zayed Bin Hamdan Al Nahyan Street, linking the community to major highways and nearby districts.

Shopping Malls Near Paradise Hills

Retail therapy is close by, with First Avenue Mall just 10 minutes away. The community also includes its own shopping centre, providing day-to-day necessities and boutique retail experiences within walking distance.

Location & Nearby Areas

Strategically positioned within Dubai Golf City, Paradise Hills enjoys excellent connectivity to several key destinations. It is just 4 minutes away from both DAMAC Hills and Dubai Studio City, ensuring quick access to leisure and business hubs. Families will appreciate the short 5-minute commute to Jebel Ali School, while motorsport enthusiasts can reach Dubai Autodrome in just 7 minutes. For retail and dining needs, First Avenue Mall is conveniently located only 10 minutes from the community.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Paradise Hills

data.answer:
From resort-style swimming pools to themed bird parks, Paradise Hills Dubai offers numerous leisure options. Residents can host weddings or social events at the multi-purpose hall or take part in wellness programs at the high-end gym.

Hotels Around Paradise Hills

Nearby hotels include Studio One Hotel in Dubai Studio City and Radisson Hotel DAMAC Hills, offering premium accommodations for visitors or staycations.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness and Beauty

Wellness is at the heart of the community. Jogging tracks, cycling lanes, and an open-air dog park cater to all age groups. The gym is fitted with advanced equipment, and plans include spas and salons for self-care within the community centre.

Community Events

The large community activity hall will host seasonal festivals, private functions, and even international conferences. These shared spaces aim to nurture community bonds and offer a platform for cultural exchange.

Attractions and Landmarks

Paradise Hills is nestled in Dubai Golf City, offering quick access to entertainment and cultural hotspots. Close to Paradise Hills are iconic spots like Dubai Autodrome and Global Village. For family entertainment, IMG Worlds of Adventure is just a short drive away.

Though Paradise Hills Dubai offers top-tier living, its off-plan status means completion timelines and resale liquidity should be evaluated. However, for those with a long-term outlook, the development’s location and amenities indicate promising future appreciation.

Where is Paradise Hills located?

Paradise Hills is located in Dubai Golf City, accessible via Sheikh Zayed Bin Hamdan Al Nahyan Street.

What types of properties are available?

Options include 3 to 6-bedroom townhouses and pent suite villas.

Is Paradise Hills a good investment?

With its strategic location and luxury amenities, Paradise Hills is considered a strong option for long-term investment.

Are there schools nearby?

Yes, Jebel Ali School is just 5 minutes away.

What amenities are included?

Amenities include a gym, pool, retail shops, themed parks, and a community event hall.

data.content:
Nestled within the evolving Dubai Golf City master development, Paradise Hills Dubai is a gated community offering a fusion of high-end living. The development by Gulf Land Property Developers spans over 2 million sq. ft., showcasing a curated collection of contemporary townhouses and pent suites. Combining resort-inspired features with family-centric design, this community aims to redefine suburban luxury.

Located along Sheikh Zayed Bin Hamdan Street, Paradise Hills, Golf City, offers proximity to some of Dubai’s prominent landmarks, including DAMAC Hills and Dubai Studio City. The upscale development promises tranquillity without compromising connectivity, making it appealing to modern urbanites and growing families.

This Paradise Hills area guide offers a closer look at why the development is gaining recognition as a standout luxury residential destination. With limited unit availability and spacious layouts tailored for upscale living, Paradise Hills Dubai is increasingly gaining attention as a potential investment hub.
